# Send an appointment reminder

Schedule a WhatsApp template before an appointment, and do not send it if the person already replied or a label says they cancelled.

A business uses Whatsable to remind someone before a time they booked, and to skip the reminder when the appointment is no longer happening.

## Set it up

**Write the reminder as a template**

Meta has to approve it before you can send it outside the 24-hour window. See [Message templates](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/message-templates).

**Add a Cancelled label**

A teammate, a keyword or an automation applies it when the appointment is off. See [Labels](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/labels).

**Schedule it**

Set the time, the template, and a condition: no reply since your last message, and none of the Cancelled label. See [Conditional follow-ups](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/conditional-follow-ups).

**Leave the check until it is due**

A reply or the Cancelled label at that moment means nothing is sent. Scheduling does not check the 24-hour window. The template is what makes the later send possible.

**Read the reply in the inbox**

Someone who confirms or asks to move the time writes back to the [inbox](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-inbox), on a plan that includes it.

Scheduled messages are on Work, Growth, Pro and Agency, on the Free plan, and during the 14-day trial. An older account on the legacy free tier has them too. Bulk Message does not.

## FAQ

**Can I send the reminder as free text?**

Only inside 24 hours of their last message. A reminder for tomorrow is a template.

**Is there a calendar connection on this page?**

No. You schedule the message in Whatsable, from the inbox, the API, Zapier, Make, n8n or an AI app. Whatsable does not read an external calendar.
